policy: Map Figma to the existing implementation. Do not restyle the application to match Figma.

bindings.name: Garden environment
rules: Native scene sprites use PIXEL_SCALE=4.
The world has its own isolated stacking context.
Sky colour -8, stars -7, satellites and UFOs -6, shooting stars -5, mountains 0, tree line 3.
Camera transforms and responsive horizon placement are owned by the renderer, not Figma frame coordinates.

bindings.name: Plant assemblies
rules: Map individual Source/Plants image variants, not padded Source/Assembly Slots or assembled screenshots.
Preserve plant folder names, filenames, crop bounds, stem overlap, hue and standby behaviour.
Plume is present in the shipped pack but has no matching source family in the inspected Figma page.

bindings.name: Board and cells
rules: Reference associations only, not published Code Connect bindings.
Current DOM, type size, spacing, scrolling, drag behaviour and mobile layout remain authoritative.
Do not copy historical sample-board colours or dimensions into runtime CSS.

bindings.name: Zone icons
rules: 9 by 9 native pixels at integer scales.
These icons intentionally use alpha masks in the text colour; this does not apply to the void tile.

bindings.name: Void background
rules: Repeat the original PNG colours at 32 by 32 CSS pixels.
Do not apply an alpha mask, resampling or recolouring.
Replace the stale Figma image with the repository artwork, not the other way around.

bindings.name: Stars and procedural sky
rules: The original GIF and its timing are protected; a Figma still image is reference-only.
Shooting stars, satellites, UFO motion and sky transitions remain generated by the renderer.

bindings.name: Brand and generated application icons
rules: Figma logo variants have not been conclusively matched to the two legacy logo PNGs.
Keep public/icon.svg and its already-generated icons unchanged; do not regenerate them from a Figma screenshot.

bindings.name: Crow and unfinished pets
rules: The inlined crow atlas is 160 by 160 with 20 by 20 frames; the Figma master sheet is 256 by 256 and must not replace it.
The 40 by 40 inline crow preview is also retained.
Pets remain disabled and greyed out. Mapping artwork does not enable a feature.
The tortoise source is design-only, not a shipped pet implementation.

bindings.name: Dynamic avatars, UI icons and drawing cursors
rules: These are renderer-owned vector or user-generated assets, not missing PNG exports.
Keep their existing source, data-driven colours, cursor hotspots and interaction states unchanged.
